title: Milo the Bear Learns to Say Thank You: The Magic Word!

lines.text: Milo the little bear loved eating delicious berry pies and sweet honeycomb!
lines.caps: Milo the little *BEAR | loved eating delicious berry *PIES | and sweet *HONEYCOMB!

lines.text: Whenever friends brought him gifts, Milo snatched them up without saying a word!
lines.caps: Whenever friends brought him *GIFTS, | Milo snatched them up without *SAYING | a *WORD!

lines.text: Soon, his friends felt unappreciated and stopped visiting his cozy treehouse!
lines.caps: Soon, his friends felt *UNAPPRECIATED | and stopped visiting his *COZY | *TREEHOUSE!

lines.text: Milo felt sad and asked his mama, Why is nobody coming over to play?
lines.caps: Milo felt *SAD | and asked his mama, Why is nobody *COMING | over to *PLAY?

lines.text: Mama smiled gently and said, People love sharing when their kindness is recognized!
lines.caps: Mama smiled gently and *SAID, | People love sharing when their *KINDNESS | is *RECOGNIZED!

lines.text: Milo baked fresh warm cookies and ran across the forest to say Thank You!
lines.caps: Milo baked fresh warm *COOKIES | and ran across the forest to *SAY | Thank *YOU!

lines.text: Thank you for the berries! Thank you for the honey! Thank you for being my friends!
lines.caps: Thank you for the *BERRIES! | Thank you for the honey! Thank you for *BEING | my *FRIENDS!

lines.text: Saying Thank You spreads warm sunshine into everyone around you!
lines.caps: Saying Thank You spreads warm *SUNSHINE | into everyone *AROUND | *YOU!

lines.text: Practice gratitude every day and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
